visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An older woman with black hair wearing a red shirt sits on a light grey sofa in a brightly lit indoor living room. She is holding a smartphone in her hands. Behind her is a large horizontal painting of flowers. A ginger and white cat walks into the frame from the left. (2) The cat jumps onto the sofa and approaches the woman's side. She lowers her phone and looks at the cat. The cat leans its head against her arm. She begins to pet the cat's head with her hand. Yellow and white text overlays appear at the bottom. (3) The scene cuts to an older man with glasses wearing a purple vest and blue pants sitting on the same sofa. He is holding a green apple and taking bites. The cat is seen walking on a dark circular side table in the foreground. (4) The cat jumps from the table onto the man's lap. The man continues eating his apple and looks toward the camera without looking down at the cat. The cat sits on his lap and looks up at him. More text overlays appear.
